facts.fact: 第七节开场：妓女 Vesna 更接带回家或带车的客人，此刻正在一辆蓝色 Fiesta 后座
facts.anchor: It’s more dangerous, but Vesna prefers the clients that take her home

facts.fact: Vesna 的理论：多数男人召妓是因为怕女人，一半工作是安抚
facts.anchor: Vesna has a theory that many of the men that go to whores do it because women scare them, and half the job consists of reassuring them

facts.fact: 她的理论规定：每个好妓女都得当一点母亲
facts.anchor: Every good hooker has to be a little bit of a mother, her theory states

facts.fact: 客人给五欧小费，其余事前付清：Vesna 学会不靠信任收账
facts.anchor: He gives her a five-euro tip (the rest of the payment was in advance: Vesna has learned not to go on trust)

facts.fact: 客人常幻想赎她离开街头，礼物先到、幻想先忘——这个 cliché 不死
facts.anchor: The Pretty Woman cliché never dies

facts.fact: Via Salaria 出城一段变成妓女的地盘，Vesna 是其中之一
facts.anchor: From there it proceeds, leaving the city to become the kingdom of hookers, Vesna among them

facts.fact: Vesna 偏好白班，因为夜里太冷
facts.anchor: The day shifts, in fact, are the ones Vesna prefers, because at night it gets so damn cold

facts.fact: Ljubcheck 是 Vesna 能碰上的最坏的皮条客
facts.anchor: Ljubcheck is the worst pimp Vesna could have found

facts.fact: Ljubcheck 初遇提出「帮忙」被拒，次日带三人强掳她上车施暴，反问她需不需要帮助
facts.anchor: he said that he’d help her, she answered that she didn’t need it. The next night Ljubcheck came back with three friends, made her get into that Mercedes, and made her feel pain and humiliation in unthinkable ways

facts.fact: Vesna 被问当晚收入时报出两百欧
facts.anchor: “Two hundred euros.”

facts.fact: Ljubcheck 嗑到这个量时连说话都危险
facts.anchor: When Ljubcheck has this much coke in him, even talking is dangerous

facts.fact: Ljubcheck 当众小便浇在她身上；车过不停
facts.anchor: A hot liquid pours over her: Ljubcheck is pissing on her. If that’s all he does, she’ll be lucky

facts.fact: 至少一打全副武装的孩子凭空出现在街上，剑、棍、匕首、上弦的弓都有
facts.anchor: There are at least a dozen children, armed to the teeth: they carry swords, batons, daggers, even a bow with an arrow nocked

facts.fact: 持弓孩子得令放箭，箭穿 Ljubcheck 肩膀
facts.anchor: The archer shoots, the arrow pierces Ljubcheck’s shoulder

facts.fact: 一个瘦黑孩子举着比自身还长的剑上前刺入 Ljubcheck 腹部
facts.anchor: A black child, thin, with a sword longer than he is tall, steps forward and stabs him in the stomach

facts.fact: 穿睡衣、颊上有大痣的小女孩上前找 Vesna
facts.anchor: A little girl in pyjamas with a large mole on one cheek approaches Vesna

facts.fact: 孩子们为「一位大领主的扈从」招人，邀请 Vesna 入伙
facts.anchor: “For the Retinue of a great lord. If you want to join, there’s a place for you

facts.fact: 入伙前女孩让她自己复仇
facts.anchor: take your revenge

facts.fact: 药效被撤走、痛感归位，是孩子们送给 Vesna 的见面礼
facts.anchor: His pain is a gift of welcome from the children to Vesna

facts.fact: Vesna 挥剑斩 Ljubcheck 的颈
facts.anchor: She brings it down on his neck

facts.fact: Wendy 二十五岁仍未成名，在派对演出手法换少量钱或免费
facts.anchor: She’s twenty-five years old and still not a famous magician

facts.fact: 父亲病前讲童话讲得好，是 Michele 对旧时光的少数记忆之一
facts.anchor: Papa used to tell them well

facts.fact: Michele 认出让他血液发凉的树味是雨后 Nemi 的气味
facts.anchor: the scent of Nemi after the rain

facts.fact: Michele 自问：对付阿尔茨海默病人身上的怪事没有猎魔人可请
facts.anchor: If you’re hunting a vampire you can call a vampire hunter

facts.fact: 电视上 Augusto Dal Mare 把暴力归因于暴力电子游戏与奇幻节目
facts.anchor: Think of the prevalence of violent videogames

facts.fact: 调查者称近期连环杀戮可能由不满十二岁的「娃娃帮」所为
facts.anchor: According to investigators, the recent killings could have been carried out by a so-called ‘baby gang’—children not even twelve years old

facts.fact: Dal Mare 自称与最初受害者之一 Luca Predasso 谈过，即 ch01 的 Wedge
facts.anchor: I have spoken with one of the first victims, Luca Predasso

facts.fact: 母亲按电视口径估计娃娃帮杀了五人，是问句不是定论
facts.anchor: it’s killed how many people, five

facts.fact: Giovanni 饭桌上问起父亲留下的期刊
facts.anchor: Do we still have Papa’s periodicals

facts.fact: Giovanni 在地下室箱中找到该期刊，按赤脚少年给的页码直翻第二十三页
facts.anchor: he goes directly to page twenty-three

facts.fact: 第 23 页文章标题：The Neverland Dream and the Psychotic Personality
facts.anchor: The Neverland Dream and the Psychotic Personality

facts.fact: 文章作者是 Stefano Cavaterra——Giovanni 的父亲
facts.anchor: Stefano Cavaterra, his father.
